notes.title: Bug Fixes [Ver1.0.1]
notes.content:
Thank you for playing World Neverland - The Story of the Olerud Kingdom.

We have taken measures to address the following issues.

- On rare occasions, the game may crash and an error may occur, making it impossible to resume.

We apologize for the inconvenience, but please update the game.

We will continue to work hard to ensure that everyone can enjoy the game comfortably, so we appreciate your continued support.
